question: In a certain code language, ‘BATTLE’ is coded as ‘4240402410’. How will ‘KINGDOM’ be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] The logic followed here is :- The alphabet positional value of letters of given word × 2. ‘BATTLE’ is coded as ‘4240402410’.
